data.standardized_narrative: Prior years' claims provisions deteriorated by GBP 4.1m in calendar 2018 (a strengthening). The movement reflected adverse development of ~GBP 2.0m in third party liability, ~GBP 2.8m in marine (aviation & transport) and ~GBP 3.4m in fire & other damage to property, partially offset by favourable development of ~GBP 2.2m in energy and ~GBP 1.8m in reinsurance acceptances. The syndicate cites a mix of large single losses and attritional development (including industry catastrophe events in 2017/2018 and specific manmade losses) as drivers of reserve change.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall deterioration of GBP 4.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Deteriorations of GBP 2.0 million on third party liability, GBP 2.8 million on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 3.4 million on fire and other damage to property were partially offset by improvements of GBP 2.2 million on energy and GBP 1.8 million on reinsurance acceptances.
Reserves in respect of the 2015 and prior years of account continue to develop satisfactorily, generating a surplus of GBP 0.7 million during the 2018 calendar year.

Following the ruling in favour of insurers in respect of the last remaining dispute in a sprawling litigation over liability from the deadly attacks on the World Trade Centre in September 2001, further releases have been made from the reserves held to cover this event.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Gross claims outstanding prior year column). Prior year development is taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which explicitly reports gross movements by class (total +GBP 4.1m deterioration). Claims development (triangle) is present in the notes (gross values in GBP '000) and was used as corroborating information. Many named event impacts are discussed narratively but specific gross amounts for individual events are not quantified in the report; hence event amounts are null. Confidence is high for balance sheet and movement-note extractions.
